lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate (skins 1/2) to tab (skins 3/4) fold, about 90.4 deg, the only formed bend. I cut perpendicular sections at 25, 50 and 75% (+-0.35 mm slabs). At every station the label point sits on the convex OUTER arc apex. Its distance along the bisector to the outermost skin point within |u|<1 mm is -0.05, +0.02 and +0.02 mm. The nearest scan point is 0.06, 0.43 and 0.18 mm away; the 0.43 mm is slab sparsity, not offset. The line runs parallel to the fold axis. It is 16.66 mm long and spans the full tab width: material along it runs about -0.5 to 17 mm, and past the end there is a gap, then the plate across the relief slot. In every global view and the side close-up it covers the whole tab edge-to-edge, from the relief slot to the outer edge. The gap in the sections just past the arc is the round hole in the tab near the bend, not an interruption of the fold. Renders are in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-idantal/db065cf7-f766-4885-b217-ed8d7edd7ade/scratchpad/goldv2/sc_d891ea8c5891/a1/ (global_12views.png, closeup_B1.png, sections_B1.png). Minor issue in the original verify_iso_under.png: B1 is drawn solid where it is occluded. This affects only the render, not the label.
